The Redbirds played their home games on [[CEFCU Arena|Doug Collins Court at CEFCU Arena]] in [[Normal, Illinois]] as members of the [[Missouri Valley Conference|Missouri Valley Conference (MVC)]]. == Previous season == The [[2023–24 Illinois State Redbirds men's basketball team|Redbirds]] finished the [[2023–24 NCAA Division I men's basketball season|2023–24 season]] 15–17, 9–11 in the [[2023–24 Missouri Valley Conference men's basketball season|Missouri Valley Conference]] play to finish in a tie for seventh place.
